verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a set of plain markdown skill folders that you install and run locally. A hands-on probe copied a skill into ./.claude/skills and read it back cleanly, and Hermes Agent installs it directly from a git clone. The skills/ directory is the harness-agnostic source of truth, and a porting guide covers new harnesses, so no vendor-hosted service is required. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license or self-hosting statement in the evidence, evidence of running fully offline or with local models (testing references Claude Code/Codex/Gemini CLI), and independent corroboration of self-hosted operation.
